findings.evidence: Confirmed declarations at lines 69–71, 80–83, and 92–96. Mathlib already uses `IsGroupLikeElem.antipode_mul_cancel`, `.isUnit`, etc. in `Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/GroupLike.lean`, and defines a `BialgHom` namespace in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Hom.lean`.
findings.fix: Rename the first theorem under `IsGroupLikeElem`; place the bialgebra-map results under `BialgHom`, reordering line 92 to take `f` before `hM`, with names such as `IsGroupLikeElem.eq_one_of_pow_eq_one`, `BialgHom.monoidAlgebra_single_eq_one`, and `BialgHom.monoidAlgebra_eq_algebraMap_counit`.
findings.issue: `eq_one_of_isGroupLikeElem_of_pow_eq_one` takes `ha : IsGroupLikeElem k a` first, while lines 80 and 92 similarly expose Mathlib `BialgHom`/`IsMulTorsion` objects first; the rubric requires such extensions to use the existing type's namespace.

summary: Three extension-style theorems are placed in `TauCeti` instead of the namespace of their first explicit argument, preventing conventional dot notation.
